notes.title: Updated Trailer Coming Mid October!
notes.content: [p]Hey Folks, it's been a while since I posted The Meat Factory page and haven't posted any updates. I'm expecting to have an updated trailer ready to go around mid-October to showcase the gameplay a little better! [b]I had initially hoped to release the game by the end of November, but now I'm expecting it to be around February.[/b][/p][p][b][u]I will do my best to actively update this page and am considering doing a "devlog" so everyone can good feel of the game.[/u][/b] [/p]
